Class GameEngine

java.lang.Object
controller.GameEngine
public final class GameEngine extends Object
Plays the turn of one player. For every roll the engine checks the forced blockade break and the void third six, runs the roll hooks, collects the legal commands from the turn rules, lets the strategy of the player choose one, executes it, and then checks captures and Mystery Cell teleports. A six or a capture gives another roll. The engine depends only on abstractions, so rules and strategies can be replaced without changing it.

    • GameEngine

      public GameEngine(List<TurnRule> turnRules, PlayerStrategyLookup strategyLookup, RollValidityRule rollValidityRule, CaptureCheckRule captureCheckRule, BlockadeBreakRule blockadeBreakRule, TeleportRule teleportRule, MysteryCellLocation mysteryCellLocation, List<RollHook> rollHooks)
      Creates an engine from the rules and strategies it needs.
      Parameters:
      turnRules - rules that list the legal commands for a roll
      strategyLookup - finds the strategy of each colour
      rollValidityRule - decides whether a roll is void (third six)
      captureCheckRule - finds the capture caused by a move
      blockadeBreakRule - finds a forced blockade break for a third six
      teleportRule - finds the Mystery Cell teleport caused by a move
      mysteryCellLocation - read-only view of the Mystery Cell, given to the strategies
      rollHooks - hooks that run after every accepted roll, for example the home gate
